pricing will be in USD for the sake of simplicity. For typical real-world pricing 
would need to be converted to GDP and add VAT. Additionally for this 
comparison, free tiers have been ignored, since this would essentially turn this 
into a contest for the largest free tier and ignore any real-world costs.
